title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order.
prompt: Implement function groupAnagrams(strs) returning groups of anagrams.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.
prompt: Implement function reverseList(head) returning the reversed linked list.

title: Linked List Cycle
description: Given head, the head of a linked list, determine if the linked list has a cycle in it.
prompt: Implement function hasCycle(head) returning true if a cycle exists.

title: Merge k Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
prompt: Implement function mergeKLists(lists) returning merged sorted linked list.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two sorted linked lists. Merge the two lists into one sorted list. Return the head of the merged linked list.
prompt: Implement function mergeTwoLists(list1, list2) returning merged list.

title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
description: Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return the head of the list.
prompt: Implement function removeNthFromEnd(head, n) removing nth node from end.

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree, and return its root.
prompt: Implement function invertTree(root) returning the inverted tree.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth. The maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node down to the farthest leaf node.
prompt: Implement function maxDepth(root) returning the maximum depth of tree.

title: Same Tree
description: Given the roots of two binary trees p and q, return true if the trees are the same. Two binary trees are considered the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value.
prompt: Implement function isSameTree(p, q) returning true if trees are identical.

title: Subtree of Another Tree
description: Given the roots of two binary trees root and subRoot, return true if there is a subtree of root with the same structure and node values of subRoot.
prompt: Implement function isSubtree(root, subRoot) checking if subRoot is a subtree.

testCases.description: Not a subtree due to extra node

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
description: Given a binary search tree (BST), find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes in the BST.
prompt: Implement function lowestCommonAncestor(root, p, q) returning LCA node.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree, find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes in the tree.
prompt: Implement function lowestCommonAncestor(root, p, q) for binary tree LCA.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values. (ie, from left to right, level by level).
prompt: Implement function levelOrder(root) returning level-order traversal.

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
description: Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. There is no restriction on how your serialization/deserialization algorithm should work.
prompt: Implement serialize(root) and deserialize(data) for binary tree.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST).
prompt: Implement function isValidBST(root) checking if tree is a valid BST.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
description: Given the root of a binary search tree, and an integer k, return the kth smallest value (1-indexed) of all the values of the nodes in the tree.
prompt: Implement function kthSmallest(root, k) returning kth smallest element.
